title: Maple Hollow Rising
author: Tamsin Crane
blurb: Lior Halloran, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
